title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental: Included Miles for Rental Days Charged
content:
On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in claim, the rental-day miles depend on the rental days charged on the contract, which are the quantities of its base rental fee lines added together:

- three or more rental days charged add **40** miles to the included-miles allowance;
- two rental days charged add **20** miles;
- a single rental day adds no miles.

## Decision table (hypothetical contracts)

| Base rental fee lines on the contract (quantity of each) | Rental days charged | Rental-day miles |
|---|---|---|
| One line, quantity 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Two lines, quantities 1 and 1 | 2 | 20 |
| Two lines, quantities 1 and 2 | 3 | 40 |
| Two lines, quantities 1 and 3 | 4 | 40 |

## Point of reading

The count is of rental days charged as they stand on the contract's base rental fee lines, read from the quantity on each line, not from the amounts and not from the number of lines.
